appAccess.instructions: All app features are available without an account.

dataCollected.handling: Archive Search sends entered terms over HTTPS to return matching stories. Standard service logs can contain the requested URL or query.
Standard HTTPS service logs can contain IP address, user agent, request time, URL, response status, and performance timing for operations, reliability, and abuse prevention.

localOnlyData: Topics, mood, theme, haptics, widget, and reminder preferences
Cached article feed and image data

deletion.localDataControls: Remove individual saved data in the app, clear app storage in Android Settings, or uninstall the app.

contentRating.questionnaireNote: NutsNews curates changing current-events summaries and links to original publisher sites. Publisher pages are outside the app and can contain material not controlled by NutsNews.

newsAndMagazines.sourceAttribution: Every story names its original publisher and links to the original article.

notifications.inAppDisclosure: A local Android notification brings you back to Today's Picks.

targetAudience.rationale: A general-audience current-events newsreader with links to independent publisher sites; it is not designed for children under 13.
